mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers a labor market correction, reducing risk premium pressures and enabling positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive despite UNRATE rising above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) both rising simultaneously signal robust demand, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rising in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising simultaneously over the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, sustained increases in the federal funds rate raise borrowing costs, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increasing in the tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day returns in the tightening cycle are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding its 2017=100 baseline signals supply chain expansion, boosting corporate profits and enabling positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive despite INDPRO crossing above 102.5739.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) both rising indicate robust demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising in the same quarter
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite GDPC1 and INDPRO not both rising simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment figures (PAYEMS) signal labor market strength, reducing uncertainty and enabling positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive despite PAYEMS rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, falling unemployment (UNRATE <4%) alongside rising employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market resilience, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE <4% and PAYEMS rising in the late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive despite UNRATE <4% and PAYEMS rising in the late-cycle expansion.
